entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments: ¶Wisdom has built her house, She has hewn out her seven pillars;

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: She has slaughtered her meat, She has mixed her wine, She has also furnished her table.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: She has sent out her maidens, She cries out from the highest places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:4
segments: "Whoever [is] simple, let him turn in here!" [As for] him who lacks understanding, she says to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:5
segments: "Come, eat of my bread And drink of the wine I have mixed.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:6
segments: Forsake foolishness and live, And go in the way of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: "He who corrects a scoffer gets shame for himself, And he who rebukes a wicked [man only] harms himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: Do not correct a scoffer, lest he hate you; Rebuke a wise [man], and he will love you.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:9
segments: Give [instruction] to a wise [man], and he will be still wiser; Teach a just [man], and he will increase in learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:10
segments: "The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One [is] understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:11
segments: For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, And [if] you scoff, you will bear [it] alone."

entries.title: Proverbs 9:13
segments: ¶A foolish woman is clamorous; [She is] simple, and knows nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: For she sits at the door of her house, On a seat [by] the highest places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: To call to those who pass by, Who go straight on their way:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: "Whoever [is] simple, let him turn in here"; And [as for] him who lacks understanding, she says to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: "Stolen water is sweet, And bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant."

entries.title: Proverbs 9:18
segments: But he does not know that the dead [are] there, [That] her guests [are] in the depths of hell.
